parsed.rationale: Both participating records carry `is_test: true` — `PlaycutMetadataMockCache.set` in `PlaycutMetadataServiceCachingTests.swift` and `EntityResolverMockCache.set` in `DiscogsAPIEntityResolverCachingTests.swift` are test-only helper methods embedded in their respective caching test files. Per the restraint rules, any cluster where even one record is test-marked must default to no-action; here both records are test fixtures. Merging these into shared test infrastructure would couple two independent test suites and obscure the intent of each mock cache, providing no production benefit.
